body:
My concern is that I know for sure, the ```EditorPackedScenePreviewPlugin``` I wrote does not create any resources by calling ```RenderingServer``` directly on thread, so it should not have problems. But others like ```EditorMaterialPreviewPlugin```, ```EditorMeshPreviewPlugin``` does. 

But I guess you're right, if it ever runs into issues, we should fix the issue directly, not reverting back to single-threaded. Working on it.

I meant `thumbnail_progress` / `_update_progress_bar` I only see in the `_idle_callback` function.

But I am also not sure whether `true` can always be forced here.
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/102313#issuecomment-2991045298
